title: Detailed crescent moon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='moonGlow' cx='40%' cy='40%' r='60%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FFFDE0'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#FFE566'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FFB830'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='crater1' cx='40%' cy='40%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#E8C840'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#D4A820'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='crater2' cx='40%' cy='40%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#E0BE38'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C89A18'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='crater3' cx='40%' cy='40%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#DDBA32'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#C09015'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Main crescent body -->
  <path d='M 62 12
           A 42 42 0 1 0 62 88
           A 34 42 0 1 1 62 12 Z'
        fill='url(#moonGlow)'/>

  <!-- Crater 1 - big, upper area -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='32' rx='7' ry='6' fill='url(#crater1)'/>
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='30' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='#FCEEA8' opacity='0.6'/>

  <!-- Crater 2 - mid area -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='52' rx='5.5' ry='4.5' fill='url(#crater2)'/>
  <ellipse cx='32.5' cy='50.5' rx='2' ry='1.8' fill='#FCEEA8' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Crater 3 - lower small -->
  <ellipse cx='40' cy='68' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='url(#crater3)'/>
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='67' rx='1.5' ry='1.3' fill='#FCEEA8' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Crater 4 - tiny near edge -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='42' rx='3' ry='2.5' fill='url(#crater2)'/>

  <!-- Crater 5 - small lower -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='60' rx='2.5' ry='2' fill='url(#crater3)'/>

  <!-- Highlight rim on inner curve -->
  <path d='M 62 12
           A 34 42 0 1 0 62 88'
        fill='none' stroke='#FFFAE8' stroke-width='1.5' opacity='0.5'/>

  <!-- Soft outer glow -->
  <path d='M 62 12
           A 42 42 0 1 0 62 88
           A 34 42 0 1 1 62 12 Z'
        fill='none' stroke='#FFE566' stroke-width='2' opacity='0.3'/>

  <!-- Sparkle stars nearby -->
  <g fill='#FFFDE0'>
    <path d='M 78 20 L 79.5 24 L 83 25 L 79.5 26.5 L 78 30 L 76.5 26.5 L 73 25 L 76.5 24 Z'/>
    <path d='M 82 62 L 83 65 L 86 66 L 83 67 L 82 70 L 81 67 L 78 66 L 81 65 Z' opacity='0.8'/>
    <path d='M 74 44 L 75 46 L 77 47 L 75 48 L 74 50 L 73 48 L 71 47 L 73 46 Z' opacity='0.7'/>
    <path d='M 85 36 L 85.8 38 L 88 38.5 L 85.8 39 L 85 41 L 84.2 39 L 82 38.5 L 84.2 38 Z' opacity='0.6'/>
  </g>

  <!-- Tiny dots as distant stars -->
  <circle cx='70' cy='16' r='1' fill='#FFFDE0' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='52' r='0.8' fill='#FFFDE0' opacity='0.5'/>
  <circle cx='72' cy='76' r='0.9' fill='#FFFDE0' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='86' cy='28' r='0.7' fill='#FFFDE0' opacity='0.5'/>
</svg>
